FN-GV5V26-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 289
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/25/2023
House Bill 289 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of law enforcement
agencies to comply with the provisions of this bill regarding guidelines for the disclosure of
body-worn cameras and dashboard cameras recordings.
In addition, this bill could further increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency to develop a recordings retention and disposition schedule for all law
enforcement agencies.

FN-GV5V26-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 289
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/26/2023
House Bill 289 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security could
increase the obligations of law enforcement agencies by an undetermined amount to comply
with the provisions of this bill regarding guidelines for the disclosure of body-worn cameras and
dashboard cameras recordings. These obligations could be offset, wholly or in-part, by any fee
charged for redaction and editing of a recording prior to the disclosure, as provided by this bill.
In addition, this bill could further increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency to develop a recordings retention and disposition schedule for all law
enforcement agencies.

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 289
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/25/2023
House Bill 289 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the obligations of law
enforcement agencies by an undetermined amount to comply with the provisions of this bill
regarding guidelines for the disclosure of body-worn cameras and dashboard cameras
recordings. These obligations could be offset, wholly or in-part, by any fee charged for redaction
and editing of a recording prior to the disclosure, as provided by this bill.
